control.question: Baseline decoded behavior under the recorded stimulus.

dnp20-off.question: Does turning decrease when DNp20 activity is removed?

dnpe017-off.question: Does forward movement / firing decrease when DNpe017 is removed?

both-off.question: What remains when both decoder outputs are removed?

mevp9-off.question: Upstream: the two MeVP9 cells that supply nearly all drive to the decoder neurons.

blank-vision.question: Does decoded behavior depend on the image at all? All receptors see black.

frozen-vision.question: Does decoded behavior depend on image changes? Receptors see the first frame forever.
